hypothesis: Can a deterministic tokenless, local-plasticity edge-binding mechanism learn the direction and sign of previously unknown synthetic causal links by intervening and observing public consequences, compose two-step links, retain learned links after cold restore, and transfer the same procedure across independently generated worlds? Do not assert superiority if a matched fully fitted conventional control matches.

worlds.split: Each (scale,seed) is a separately generated complete synthetic world; no graph edge/candidate label is provided to learner before scoring; all worlds DEV, not protected unseen first-use
worlds.world_generation: For each source node choose the two lowest-hash-ranked distinct nonself target IDs under sha256('F44/world/v1|N|seed|source|target'), assigning the first a + edge and second a - edge. Each node has exactly 1 excitatory and 1 inhibitory outgoing edge, no self edge, all other directed pairs are zero.
worlds.public_observation: Intervention do(source=0 or 1) and record public binary outcome for every target at one time step; no graph parents, edge IDs, law parameters or answer labels passed to learner.
worlds.observation_law: P(y=1 | do(source=a), target=t) is 1/4 for unrelated target and for + edge with a=0; 7/8 for + edge with a=1; 7/8 for - edge with a=0; 1/4 for - edge with a=1. Deterministic Bernoulli draw via first 8 bytes of sha256('F44/obs/v1|N|seed|source|action|replicate|target') scaled to [0,2^64).
worlds.fixed_intervention_order: For each node in numeric ascending order, for each replicate in [0..23], intervene on action=0 then action=1 (balanced); every chosen action and its target response vector is observable only after taking that action.
worlds.observations_subset_rule: For reduced budgets use exact prefix of first b replicate rounds per source/action (same source world/seed); no new samples or ad hoc selection; evaluate 24 first in reporting, then 12, then 6.

methods.native_dev: Implement isolated local tokenless signed-association weights w[source,target] int16, updated by (2*a-1)*(2*y-1) on each public action-outcome vector (same action0/1 counts per source). Predict +/− only if per-target signed weight >=2*ceil(0.45*repeats_per_arm) or <=negative threshold. Exact integer, no gradients, source graph never used in update.
methods.fully_trained_conventional: Fit independent two-arm Bernoulli empirical maximum-likelihood response rates per (source,target) using all action/outcome samples, threshold their fitted difference at same 0.45. This is fully fit for the specified factorized Bernoulli family, not a weaker unfitted baseline. It has identical exposures, source IDs, target IDs, actions, and outcomes.
methods.same_capacity_conventional: Control with one signed contrast counter per (source,target), same weights/known action counts as native; must match native exactly if both implement the same sufficient statistic. Disclose parity, not intelligence.
methods.perfect_oracle: Exact hidden true signed graph scores only in evaluator, never passed to learners; ceiling on source to target edge and two-hop queries.
shams: Passive action=0 only -> cannot identify causal contrasts and must abstain
Wrong-source label permutation: train same public observations under (source+1)%N and evaluate original IDs, must score strictly below correct learned model at highest-width stage
Cold checkpoint corruption must be rejected; deliberate additional isolated observations must not mutate a different source row.

metrics: direct precision, recall, macro world F1
2-hop signed composition precision, recall, F1 on pairs with exactly one two-hop signed path (ambiguous multi-paths excluded by evaluation rule)
false nonedge predictions across full N*(N-1) bounded synthetic universe
native-vs-MLE and same-capacity control paired per world
interference preservation of unrelated trained source rows
bytes for learned weights/counters/full checkpoint; total actions and public outcome bits
fit and inference wall-clock times separately, exploratory only
frozen_evaluation.pass_rule: DEV_CAUSAL_EDGE_INDUCTION_GO only when every (size, seed) at highest budget meets direct/2hop thresholds and controls/retention, otherwise DEV_CAUSAL_EDGE_INDUCTION_NO_GO; lower budgets diagnostic only and must not rescue highest-budget failure; report strongest fitted conventional comparison without thresholding it away.
frozen_evaluation.scientific_pass_rule: Always FALSE. Worlds, seeds, laws and test procedure all known in advance; no prospective held-out world custody, independent replication or compute-matched strongest native/conventional scientific control. Count observed successes as developmental mechanism capability only.
frozen_evaluation.compute_and_safety: All source-free deterministic stdlib experiments; no new external source, paid API, simulator runner, controller, scheduled task, accepted Yggdrasil code, F42/F43 changes, protected scientific first-use or model promotion; only research contribution and existing CI.
